title: Design and simulation of the potential of lead-free Ag3Bi1.1I6.3 perovskite solar cells with different charge transport for energy enhancement
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27558-27575
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04146E, Paper
Open Access

Md Aminul Islam, M. Khalid Hossain, M. Shihab Uddin, Apon Kumar Datta, Sahjahan Islam, Pardeep Singh Bains, Rohit Sharma, A. Rajiv, Abdullah M. S. Alhuthali, Magda H. Abdellattif, D. K. Dwivedi, Rajesh Haldhar
Here SCAPS-1D simulation is utilized to develop the PSCs, which comprise an Ag3Bi1.1I6.3 absorber, C6TBTAPH2 hole transport layer (HTL), and four distinct electron transport layers (ETLs) (STO, MZO, ZnSe, PC60BM) under standard illumination.
